name: Countryball Neighborhood
desc:
🌍 Welcome to Countryball Neighborhood! 🌟

🧭 In this game, you can become any country in the world, such as France, the United States of America, the United Kingdom, and many more!
🌐 Select your preferred country and start roleplaying as it! 
🤝 Make new alliances, declare wars, and even build empires! Explore the town map with your friends, which will expand in future updates! 🤝
🖌️ Use the paintable map to redraw world map borders, create new countries, and create alt history scenarios! 🖌️

(Press Shift to sprint)
(Edit your RP-name using /name or /resetname)

👍 Thumbs up and favorite for more future updates
